description: End-to-end repro of TAT-3065. Closes any pre-existing AVAX position, then places a real Hyperliquid $10 market long on AVAX via the order-entry UI with auto-close TP/SL filled in. Asserts the resulting positionTPSL trigger orders (a) come back from HL with isPositionTpsl=true, (b) populate the Auto-close row on the market detail page, and (c) do not appear in the Orders section. Teardown closes the AVAX position.
title: TAT-3065 real $10 AVAX market+TPSL via UI

gate-cleanup-pre-existing-avax.expression: (async()=>{try{var p=await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsGetPositions',[]);var avax=(p||[]).find(x=>x.symbol==='AVAX');if(avax){await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsClosePosition',[{symbol:'AVAX',orderType:'market'}]);for(var i=0;i<20;i++){var p2=await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsGetPositions',[]);if(!(p2||[]).find(x=>x.symbol==='AVAX')){return JSON.stringify({ok:true,closed:true,attempts:i})}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500))}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'failed to close pre-existing AVAX position'})}return JSON.stringify({ok:true,closed:false})}catch(e){return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:String(e&&e.message||e)})}})()

setup-toggle-autoclose.expression: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('[data-testid="auto-close-toggle"]');if(!el){return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'auto-close-toggle not found'})}var label=el.closest('label.toggle-button');if(!label){return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'toggle-button label not found'})}var track=label.querySelector('div[style]')||label.firstElementChild;(track||label).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window}));return JSON.stringify({ok:true})})()

setup-wait-submit-enabled.expression: (async()=>{for(var i=0;i<20;i++){var b=document.querySelector('[data-testid="submit-order-button"]');if(b&&!b.disabled){return JSON.stringify({ok:true,attempts:i})}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250))}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'submit button stayed disabled',tpErr:document.querySelector('[data-testid="tp-validation-error"]')?.innerText,slErr:document.querySelector('[data-testid="sl-validation-error"]')?.innerText})})()

setup-wait-fill.expression: (async()=>{for(var i=0;i<40;i++){var p=await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsGetPositions',[]);var avax=(p||[]).find(x=>x.symbol==='AVAX');if(avax){return JSON.stringify({ok:true,attempts:i,size:avax.size,entry:avax.entryPrice,liq:avax.liquidationPrice,tp:avax.takeProfitPrice,sl:avax.stopLossPrice})}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500))}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'AVAX position did not appear within 20s of submit'})})()

setup-wait-tpsl-orders.expression: (async()=>{for(var i=0;i<30;i++){var o=await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsGetOpenOrders',[]);var triggers=(o||[]).filter(x=>x.symbol==='AVAX'&&x.isTrigger===true&&x.reduceOnly===true);if(triggers.length>=2){return JSON.stringify({ok:true,attempts:i,allPositionTpsl:triggers.every(t=>t.isPositionTpsl===true),triggers:triggers.map(t=>({orderId:t.orderId,detailedOrderType:t.detailedOrderType,triggerPrice:t.triggerPrice,isPositionTpsl:t.isPositionTpsl,size:t.size}))})}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500))}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,reason:'AVAX trigger orders did not appear within 15s'})})()

setup-wait-render.expression:
(async()=>{for(var i=0;i<20;i++){var row=document.querySelector('[data-testid="perps-auto-close-row"]');var text=row?.innerText||'';if(text.includes('$11')&&text.includes('$9')&&!text.includes('TP

-')&&!text.includes('SL

-')){return JSON.stringify({ok:true,text:text,attempts:i})}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500))}return JSON.stringify({ok:false,text:document.querySelector('[data-testid="perps-auto-close-row"]')?.innerText,reason:'Auto-close row did not show $11 / $9 within 10s'})})()

ac-screenshot-final.note: AC1+AC2: real $10 AVAX market long submitted via UI with TP $20 / SL $5 produces positionTPSL orders (isPositionTpsl=true) that route to Auto-close row, not the Orders section.
